definitions.head: per frame, opaque pixels above the teal collar: per column, rows above the first teal pixel found between 4 rows above the collar row and the collar row (or above collar row + 1 where the column has none). Collar row = first row 18+ below the head top with 4+ teal pixels. Same code as fix_headlock.segment.
definitions.head_redraw_unaligned: for each consecutive pair f0-f1 ... f6-f7 and the loop f7-f0: share of the union of both head masks whose pixel differs in alpha or colour, no shift. Includes whole-head motion.
definitions.head_redraw_aligned: the same share after the best integer shift of the second head within +-3 px: what is redrawn, not moved. 0 means the same head moved as a whole.
definitions.wrong_eye_px: face band (head top + 12 to collar row - 3): pixels that are blue (b > r+25 and b > g+30) or shirt teal (g > r+40, |g-b| <= 30, g > 60)
definitions.bluish_eye_px: same band, looser: b > r+15 and b >= g
definitions.frame formulas: dark_outline_share, colours, palette distance, neighbour_diff, loop_seam_ratio as in build_compare.py
